name: vscode
one_liner: The most widely used free code editor, which developers build and sell custom add-ons for.
buyer: An indie extension developer selling premium add-ons, or a consultancy selling standardized dev-tooling setups to engineering teams.
business_use_cases: An extension developer builds and sells a premium extension, such as specialized linting or a niche language's tooling, with a license-key paywall.
A dev-tools consultancy configures and maintains standardized editor setups (extensions, settings, debug configs) for engineering teams, billed as onboarding packages.
A course creator teaches 'power user' workshops to boost developer productivity at companies.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a premium extension with a license-key paywall

steal_this: Ship a focused premium extension this weekend, such as a niche code-review helper, and sell license keys directly.
